author: N6rL
content: ADR-004: job file drop. Rationale: DESIGN.md principle 6 requires jobs to be addressable/retryable/inspectable — stdin/stdout pipe evaporates. File drop naturally becomes the local-queue-backend when Redis/Celery arrives. Job dir layout: .alcanzai/jobs/<uuid>/{raw_document.json, result.json, status.json}.
